name: NEUCA S.A.
summary: NEUCA S.A. engages in the wholesale distribution of pharmaceuticals in Poland. It operates through Wholesale Distribution of Medicines, Manufacture of Pharmaceuticals, Medical Operator, Clinical Trials, and Insurance Activities segments. The company offers Rx, OTC drugs, dietary supplements, medical devices, dermocosmetics, hygiene products, personal protective equipment, as well as diagnostic and dressing materials under the Swiat Zdrowia, APTEO, GENOPTIM, CERA+ Solutions, and Kic Kic brands.
